receipt.json.candidate_history: native retained pose stamps; stable source IDs

diagnostic_noise.assumption: independent diagonal measurement errors; not sensor calibration

receipt.json.scope:
Replay same-session raw cameras/IMU and original sonar event times.

By default no acoustic factors are supplied. An explicit measured track trace
and diagnostic noise scales enable same-clock acoustic factor replay. This is
transport/optimizer evidence, not calibrated fusion or map accuracy.

camera.viewpoint: isometric direction; positive X forward, Y left, Z up

metrics.gauge: initial yaw and translation only; gravity tilt retained; scale fixed at 1; no trajectory fit
metrics.scope: Recorded trajectory only; does not qualify product accuracy or initialization/recovery

acoustic-comparison.json.scope: Same-recording static scene comparison; actual RGB reference captured after mission; acoustic hypotheses

surface-evaluation.json.scope: Post-estimation point-to-triangle distances to physical collision boxes and static seabed; not physical track identity or area coverage
surface-evaluation.json.alignment: initial yaw and translation only; scale 1; simulator geometry used only for evaluation
